title: gettext variables
description: Configuration variables for GNU gettext utilities (msgfmt, xgettext).

GETTEXT_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install gettext. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, or 'from-source' compiles from source.

GETTEXT_VERSION.description: Specific version of gettext to install.

GETTEXT_INSTALL_DIR.description: Target directory for isolated gettext installation.

GETTEXT_OFFLINE.description: Flag (true/false or 1/0) indicating air-gapped offline installation mode for gettext.

GETTEXT_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading gettext binary or archive artifacts.

GETTEXT_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying gettext available remote releases.
